scope: Original model class definitions only; smaller vocabulary, width and depth; compare initialization, logits, CE loss, gradients and one AdamW step. First case retains GPT-2 head dimension 64.
numerical_note: The original attention scales by multiplication with the reciprocal; this implementation divides by sqrt(head_dim). At non-default head dimension 8 in FP32, a preliminary check found up to 2.0831823348999023e-05 parameter difference after AdamW despite close gradients. FP64 is used for the additional non-default-dimension comparison. No claim of identical arbitrary-config FP32 trajectories or tokenizer equivalence.
